description.short: Find hotel pricing and schedule meetings.
description.full: Ask the advisor to look up hotel pricing, get price forecasts, schedule meetings, and find available rooms and amenities. Powered by Azure AI Foundry.

commands.title: Hotel pricing
commands.description: Get pricing for a hotel (e.g. 'Prices at Hilton Paris 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-05')

commands.title: Price forecast
commands.description: Forecast hotel prices for a destination (e.g. 'Forecast for Barcelona in August')

commands.title: Schedule meeting
commands.description: Book a meeting room (e.g. 'Schedule a board meeting for 10 people next Tuesday at 2pm')
